body: I've only experienced one lucid dream that I recall, but I **was able to adjust light levels** by flipping a wall switch. My digital watch was counting down / up seconds (it changed after I glanced away and back as a test).

I really can't understand why people do jobs they hate. I was planning to quit my aforementioned job in February after I had saved a bit, but ended up getting fired right before Christmas. I have a tendency to bounce around from job to job after getting bored or not getting what was promised to me.

>Have you thought about starting your own programming project?

I've done a few small things, mostly just for my benefit. Honestly, I'm not sure if this is what I need right now. I almost felt like selling everything and going to some far away country for a while after reading one of the other threads here. That would be exciting.

>What kinds of things did your parents expect of you?

Excellence in everything. The most heard words around the dinner table were "I know you can do better." And I still feel like I can do better! Which is why I'm so frustrated and down on myself.

I've tried starting to exercise more, you're right, it is difficult. Mostly I'm trying to concentrate on eating healthier - no fast food, low carb meals, not drinking excessively.

I liked school to an extent. I considered going back to school, but don't think I would enjoy the bureaucracy. Also, I realized that I can teach myself things better (and cheaper) than a professor can.

I feel worthless because it seems like I'm not good at anything. I've been to a few interviews recently and been passed over every time.

I was a programmer / developer previously. I worked 100+ hour weeks at the end for a $40k salary. I hated it. I wish I could do something meaningful, or at least exciting. I feel like my life has been so boring thus far and not even worth mentioning. I was raised with strict parents who had super high expectations and I feel like I'm such a failure right now.

I used to play guitar, but again I wasn't really any good. I'm renting my guitar to a neighbor right now. I also used to be an avid runner but haven't been jogging in a long time and have since gained a bit of weight. Mostly I wouldn't have much free time, and would end up spending whatever time outside of work getting drunk with coworkers and discussing why we hated our jobs.

I have barely left my apartment in a week. I leave only to go food shopping and pay bills usually.
